bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-autoack-5bac2a0-20261119"
compose="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
secret="$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt"
backup="$root/deploy/secrets/.bug_report_recipient.pre-autoack-20261119"
oldtag="gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-pre-autoack-20261119"
newtag="gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-autoack-5bac2a0"
test -f "$compose" && test -s "$secret" || exit 60
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "5bac2a001e3617dcb44214158059349a54cf8cff" || exit 61
git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)" "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 63
expected="$(awk -F '"' '/MENU_PUBLISH_ADMIN_ID:/ {print $2; exit}' "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml")"
test -n "$expected" && [[ "$expected" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 64
oldvalue="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$secret")"
test -n "$oldvalue" && [[ "$oldvalue" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 65
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 66
cid="${ids[0]}"
project="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}')"
test -n "$project" && test "$project" != "<no value>" || exit 67
test -n "$(docker image inspect "$newtag" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 68
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local "$oldtag"
cp -p "$secret" "$backup"
chmod 600 "$backup"
changed=0
rollback(){
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 if [ "$changed" = 1 ]; then
  cp -p "$backup" "$secret"
  docker image tag "$oldtag" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
  docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 echo GAYBBS_RELEASE=ROLLBACK_REQUIRED
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
umask 077
tmp="$(mktemp "$root/deploy/secrets/.recipient.XXXXXXXX")"
printf '%s\n' "$expected" > "$tmp"
chmod 600 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$secret"
changed=1
docker image tag "$newtag" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
newcid="$(docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" ps -q gaybbs)"
test -n "$newcid" || exit 69
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if [ "$(docker inspect "$newcid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true ] && docker logs "$newcid" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY'; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" -eq 1 || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
test "$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$secret")" = "$expected" || exit 72
changed=0
trap - ERR
echo GAYBBS_RELEASE=PASS
echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY=PASS
echo REPORT_RECIPIENT_PRIVATE_SETTING=VERIFIED
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_PRESERVED=PASS
